carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Visible horizontal ridge running along the lateral flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance transition with a light dorsal edge and shadowed ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct white linear abrasions on the dorsal surface posterior to the head; several small commensal organisms (remoras) attached to the ventral-lateral area.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast caustic network patterns caused by surface light refraction projected across the subject's dorsal and lateral surfaces.
